ideas.name: Nordic Tray-Fit PFAS-Free Baking Liner
ideas.concept: Platinum-cured silicone (no PTFE) reusable oven liners pre-cut to exact Swedish/Danish standard oven tray sizes, with printed cut-guides and a migration-test report card.
ideas.target_customer: Home bakers and meal-preppers in SE/DK, 28-55, who want to stop buying disposable baking paper.
ideas.problem_solved: PFAS-coated baking paper/PTFE mats are being pushed out; generic liners do not fit Nordic trays.
ideas.trend_evidence: PPWR bans PFAS in food-contact packaging from 12 Aug 2026; one industry blog lists baking paper as in scope (secondary source). Bisphenol FCM ban phases in 2026-2029 incl. silicones. I did not verify consumer search/sales growth for liners; generic silicone liners already exist on Amazon.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Exact tray-fit SKUs per oven brand, third-party migration/LFGB test report, Nordic design; moderate copy-resistance (generic liners are cheap).

ideas.name: Tare-Marked Steel Cafe Box
ideas.concept: Stock 18/8 stainless leak-proof lunch/takeaway box with laser-engraved tare weight and volume on the lid, designed to be accepted by cafes for bring-your-own fill.
ideas.target_customer: Urban SE/DK commuters, office workers and eco-minded households.
ideas.problem_solved: Cafes must accept customers' own containers from Feb 2027; staff need quick hygiene/weight/volume cues.
ideas.trend_evidence: PPWR requires BYO-container options for takeaway from 12 Feb 2027 (some sources say 2027, reuse offer 2028); Sweden already requires reusable options since Jan 2024; Copenhagen and Aarhus run reusable takeaway return schemes. Evidence on consumers actually bringing own containers is mixed (WSJ cited as showing weak uptake).
ideas.defensibility_angle: Tare/size standard plus cafe-partner programme and QR; copyable hardware but brand/standard and cafe network are the moat.

ideas.name: Carbon-Steel Seasoning Balm
ideas.concept: Food-grade oil and beeswax seasoning/maintenance balm in a refillable tin for carbon-steel and cast-iron pans, sold with a refill pouch.
ideas.target_customer: Home cooks switching from non-stick to carbon steel/cast iron.
ideas.problem_solved: Switching away from PFAS non-stick requires seasoning care that is intimidating; balm makes it easy and repeatable.
ideas.trend_evidence: Euronews (Oct 2026) reports pressure on Tefal/SEB to drop PFAS from non-stick; France banned PFAS in cosmetics/clothing/ski wax from Jan 2026 but dropped cookware; EU-wide PFAS restriction: RAC opinion Mar 2026, SEAC final expected end-2026, full ban unlikely before ~2030. Demand for seasoning products not directly verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Proprietary formulation (non-polymerising oil blend, avoid flax self-heating risk), refill subscription, pan-care content/community.
ideas.tooling_needed: None; stock tins and contract blender; check CLP/food-contact status.

ideas.name: Heat-Keep Pot Cozy
ideas.concept: Insulated textile cooking cozy (recycled/wool-blend with reflective liner) that lets a pot finish cooking off-heat, sized for common 20-26 cm pots.
ideas.target_customer: Energy-conscious Danish/Swedish households and induction users; camping/cabin owners.
ideas.problem_solved: Cuts cooking energy and keeps food warm without electronics or batteries.
ideas.trend_evidence: Danish sources describe 2026 electricity price rises and consumer concern; CLASP notes electric hobs cost-effective in Sweden. I found no direct data on thermal-cooker or cozy demand, so this is a hypothesis with unverified trend.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Insulation know-how (VELUX background), measured energy-saving test data and design; copyable cut-and-sew, so brand/test claims matter.

ideas.name: Glue-Free Solid Wood Board
ideas.concept: Single-piece FSC beech/birch cutting board, no resin joins, with juice groove and knife-guide engraving, positioned as a plastic-board replacement.
ideas.problem_solved: Plastic boards shed microparticles; many cheap bamboo boards use resin glues.
ideas.trend_evidence: ACS-published study showed plastic boards shed microplastics; media report chefs moving to wood, but FDA says evidence of harm is not shown and the category is crowded. No 2026-specific trend verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Weak; only design, FSC provenance and Nordic branding. Included as a low-priority candidate.
